decision.rationale: As Public Access and Inclusion, I need to identify who cannot access care and which alternative channels exist. The telecom regulator may hold information about the network incident affecting public telecommunications services, which is relevant to understanding access disruptions. I will request network_incident_status from the telecom regulator. I do not yet know the scope of the outage, which user groups are affected, or what alternative access channels are available.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information about the network incident from the telecom regulator to understand service disruptions affecting public access.

citations.quote_span: Without violation to any applicable legislations, whoever circulates information related to the patients must keep its confidentiality and not to use them except in the health purposes without written approval from the patient, except in any of the following cases:
citations.relevance: Confidentiality constraint applicable to any information sharing about patient-related impacts.

uncertainty: Scope and duration of the network incident
Which populations or geographic areas cannot access care
Whether alternative access channels (e.g., in-person, phone, other digital platforms) are available and operational
